newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha climbs $2 but physical stays quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha climbs $2 but physical stays quiet.

text.p: The European naphtha market rose $2 a tonne on Thursday extending gains made on Wednesday when the rest of the oil complex fell, traders said.
Despite thin discussions on the physical market swaps were well bid on nearby periods with May pegged around $186 and June $2 higher.
"Its really quiet on the physical. There are just two or three cargoes and buyers," said a trader.
He pegged full range cargoes at between $4 and $5 a tonne above the quotes and saw little impact from falling refinery margins in Rotterdam.
